snippet.title: My Name Is Vincent Pogo - Early Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
You've heard of Vincent Van Gogh, but have you heard of Vincent Pogo? 
We are excited to finally introduce everyone to our adventure pogo-sticking physics game.

This is some early gameplay footage in some playground areas that demonstrate the game in a nutshell. Made by 3 developers using Unreal Engine 5.
